about: Chernihiv: an ancient city that is rebuilding

Chernihiv is one of Ukraine's oldest cities, with a low-rise centre, estates of apartment blocks and a large private sector along the Desna. Since 2022 many homes here have been restored or built anew.

For damaged houses we start with a survey: which parts of the structure can be kept and which need strengthening or replacing. Only then come the project, the estimate and the renovation, so that money does not go into finishes on an unreliable base.

Rebuilding is a chance to rethink the layout: join the kitchen and living room, add a walk-in wardrobe and a second bathroom, plan energy-efficient systems. If the volume of the house changes, we do the interior together with the architecture. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments and houses, from major renovation with new services to finishing, and do [house reconstruction](/en/house-reconstruction) after a survey. For plots near the Desna the project accounts for groundwater and waterproofing.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
